final: WITH joined AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id), grp AS (SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY bats), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp), avg_g AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgc FROM grp) SELECT grp.bats, grp.cnt, grp.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total AS share, grp.cnt * 1.0 / avg_g.avgc AS count_over_avg FROM grp CROSS JOIN tot CROSS JOIN avg_g ORDER BY grp.bats
